description: Prediction-market odds and implied probability, $0.01. Ask for an event or topic and get the live Polymarket markets that match: each outcome's implied probability and decimal odds, best bid/ask and spread, book liquidity, 24h and 1wk volume, days to resolution, and a deterministic 0-100 edge/attention score with the concrete flags named (wide_spread, thin_liquidity, resolving_within_24h, sharp_move_24h, close_call). Use when you need the market-implied probability of an event - an election, a Fed decision, a match, a price level - rather than a headline opinion. One venue, read live.

q.description: Event or topic, in the venue's own wording, e.g. 'Fed rate decision', 'Bitcoin above 150k', 'Super Bowl'

name: prediction_odds
